answer: Each answer must embed the solution of the previous epoch's puzzle, chaining identity across epochs so a key that skips an epoch cannot rejoin without redoing the missed work. A farm that pauses for one epoch loses its whole chain and must redo every missed puzzle before answering again, while a steady honest agent just keeps its chain alive. The nadir of the design is public, the sable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the vault of honest work is what finally pays.
